checks.reason: The predicate directly asserts the boolean symbol meaning the user has a pending withdrawal request in an active epoch E.

The intent says executeWithdrawal must not revert when zero shares were fulfilled, but the predicate only forbids revert when a pending request also exists, adding an unstated condition and misplacing the trigger.
The predicate asserts the transaction reverted together with a pending request and zero fulfilled shares, matching the claim that affected users cannot execute withdrawals.

piv_relation.reason: V asserts revert while I forbids revert under the same pending-request and zero-shares conditions, so V contradicts I rather than being a distinguishable violation of it.
